inherited_review_scope: Prior independent per-model raw scoring, input pins and binding audits referenced through exact same reports/bindings; no recursive collect rerun or all-training evidence rehash.

Four representative clips do not replace full condition/lane quantitative results.
No physics reintegration, new simulation or policy inference; measurement/force staging is not independent physics integration verification.
Original scientific_acceptance=false and independent_review_pending fields preserved; not whole-goal completion.
